text:
Assistant A is clearly better.

The user asked for each of the four questions to be assigned to one category, with no extraneous words and one topic per line. Assistant A does this: Literature (Tolstoy), History (the US in WWII), Science (the water Lewis structure), and Art (the Mona Lisa). It is concise and correct, and it follows the required format. Its only weakness is that it omits question numbers, which makes the mapping slightly less explicit, but the order is clear.

Assistant B violates nearly every instruction. It adds extensive extraneous text, including a repetitive and self-contradictory Literature section that duplicates the same volume descriptions. Its History section is a generic, padded description of the United States rather than an assignment. Its Science section starts answering the water question rather than categorizing it, and it is cut off mid-sentence. It never assigns the Art question at all.

[[A]]
